nodes.name: inline-input.css
nodes.summary: Styles the borderless inline text input that inherits surrounding typography and shows only a focus ring shadow.

nodes.name: keybind.css
nodes.summary: Styles the keyboard shortcut badge as a small centered chip with surface background, border shadow, and 12px regular text.

nodes.name: list.css
nodes.summary: Styles the selectable/filterable list component: filter input, groups, items with selected/active/extra icons, dividers, empty state, and a scroll fade animation.

nodes.name: logo.css
nodes.summary: Sets the logo mark dimensions with a fixed 16px width and 4/5 aspect ratio.

nodes.name: markdown.css
nodes.summary: Styles rendered markdown output with a typography reset, uniform heading sizes distinguished by color, dense element spacing, and code blocks with a copy button that swaps check/copy icons.

nodes.name: message-nav.css
nodes.summary: Styles the message timeline navigator with nav items, message/tick buttons, a tick line, title previews, and a hover tooltip.

nodes.name: message-part.css
nodes.summary: The largest component stylesheet: styles every chat message part renderer (assistant/user messages, tool outputs, diffs, bash output, diagnostics, compaction parts, apply-patch diffs, edit content, dock prompt, code) with prefers-color-scheme dark adjustments.
nodes.languageNotes: 1,275 lines of per-part overrides that effectively catalog every message part variant; relies on native CSS nesting and dark-scheme media queries.

nodes.name: popover.css
nodes.summary: Styles the anchored popover with open/close animations, arrow, header/title/description/body slots, and a close button.

nodes.name: progress-circle.css
nodes.summary: Styles the circular progress indicator as a -90deg-rotated SVG with weak background stroke and an active stroke whose dash-offset animates via cubic-bezier transition.
nodes.languageNotes: Circular progress via stroke-dashoffset transition instead of keyframes.

nodes.name: progress.css
nodes.summary: Styles the linear progress bar with track, fill, header, label, and value-label slots plus an indeterminate animation.

nodes.name: provider-icon.css
nodes.summary: Sets fixed 16x16 non-shrinking dimensions for provider logo icons.

nodes.name: radio-group.css
nodes.summary: Styles the radio group form control with wrapper, items, hidden native input, custom control with animated indicator, and labels.

nodes.name: resize-handle.css
nodes.summary: Styles edge and corner resize handles with direction and edge variants, hover/active visibility transitions, and matching resize cursors.

nodes.name: scroll-view.css
nodes.summary: Styles the custom-scrollable view: hidden native scrollbars, a styled thumb with hover and dragging states, and dark-mode adjustments.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses both scrollbar-width: none and ::-webkit-scrollbar to suppress native scrollbars cross-browser.

nodes.name: select.css
nodes.summary: Styles the select dropdown with a trigger showing value and chevron icon, an open-animated content list, and items with check indicators.

nodes.name: session-review.css
nodes.summary: Styles the session review UI with container, change groups, per-change rows, accordion items and content, actions, and embedded radio-group overrides for change dispositions.

nodes.name: session-turn.css
nodes.summary: Styles the session turn grouping with assistant content, compaction sections, and collapsible diffs groups featuring chevron, directory, filename, and path meta rows.

nodes.name: shell-submessage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the inline shell/tool sub-message layout used inside message parts, keeping values on the text baseline with clipped width slots.
nodes.languageNotes: Has no sibling shell-submessage.tsx; its data-component selectors are consumed by message-part.tsx.

nodes.name: spinner.css
nodes.summary: Minimal sizing for the loading spinner: inherits color, renders as an 18px square that never shrinks.

nodes.name: sticky-accordion-header.css
nodes.summary: Makes the accordion header sticky with a CSS-variable-driven top offset stack and an opaque background to hide scrolling content behind it.
nodes.languageNotes: Top offset composes two custom properties (--sticky-accordion-top + --sticky-accordion-offset) so parents can stack sticky headers.
